author: pratik-anurag
title: Snow Bubble
description: A soap bubble comes down close to the lens on a moonlit snowfield, with snow mountains behind it and other bubbles falling far off. Frost spreads over its shell from the snow or from flakes landing on it, layer on layer, until it is white all over. Then it bursts into thin curved flakes that flutter down into the snow.
ogAlt: A large soap bubble close to the camera on moonlit snow, with frost ferns climbing its film, snow-covered mountains behind it, smaller bubbles falling far off and a faint aurora in the sky
canvasLabel: A soap bubble comes down close to the camera onto a snowfield under a quiet night sky, with snow-covered mountains and stands of snow-laden spruce behind it and smaller bubbles falling far off across the field. Frost spreads over its surface from where it touches the snow or from flakes landing on its top and sides, while crystals drift, join and lock together, layer on layer until the shell is white. Then a tear races round it, and the shell becomes thin curved flakes that hang for a moment in the bubble's shape and flutter down. Each night has its own moon, thin or half or full, or none at all. A faint aurora comes and goes, and high on a far ridge a snow leopard now and then crosses the skyline.
